rv.q: This cheerfully raunchy musical about the travails of finding your purpose in life when you're something of a loser is probably the most honest show about being young and single in the city since 'Company.'
Avenue Q is a show that succeeds because it doesn't take itself too seriously, yet still manages to say something meaningful about the search for purpose that defines so much of early adult life.
A lively time with lots of laughs awaits theatergoers who take a trip to "Avenue Q."
